name: elemix-ssr-benchmarks
description: SSR benchmark harness: hydris vs asp vs next.js vs nuxt

scripts.pack:hydris: cd ../elemix/packages/hydris && rm -rf artifacts && for p in Hydris Hydris.QuickJs Hydris.Generators Hydris.Build Hydris.Cli; do dotnet pack "$p/$p.csproj" -c Release -o ./artifacts || exit 1; done
scripts.install:hydris: pnpm run pack:hydris && cd hydris && pnpm install && dotnet nuget locals all --clear && dotnet tool restore
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run install:next && pnpm run install:nuxt && pnpm run install:asp && pnpm run install:hydris
scripts.clean: rm -rf nextjs/node_modules nextjs/.next nuxt/node_modules nuxt/.nuxt nuxt/.output hydris/node_modules hydris/bin hydris/obj hydris/ssr hydris/.hydris-build hydris/public/_elemix asp/bin asp/obj ../elemix/packages/hydris/artifacts
scripts.reset: pnpm run clean && pnpm run bootstrap
